rules.statement: The Supreme Court may grant relief in revision at the instance of one of the heirs of a deceased defendant in a partition action where an interlocutory decree is entered after the death of the contesting defendant and before substitution of his heirs.
rules.supporting_quote: Where interlocutory decree is entered in a partition action after the death of a contesting defendant and before substitution of his heirs, the Supreme Court may grant relief in revision at the instance of one of the heirs of the deceased defendant.
